disease_group.description: Label of the disease sub-group (must exist in disease.groups)

groups.description: Sub-groups, each with label and sample_paths (and optional level_labels_path, samples_base_path)
groups.title: Groups

label.description: Display name for this side (e.g. caucasians, prostate cancer)

GroupConfig.description:
One cohort or one level within a cohort.
If level_labels_path is set, this group is expanded into one logical group per level
(sample_paths are split by the level column); centroid dirs are created per level.
When subcluster is set and persist_centroids is True, MethylCluster runs first and the group
is expanded into one sub-group per cluster (e.g. healthy_c0, healthy_c1); no single centroid
for the parent label is built. When samples_base_path is set (project or group), sample_paths
may be paths to CSV/text files containing only sample folder names (one per line or one column);
each name is resolved to samples_base_path / name.

description.description: Human-readable meaning of this cohort or stage (e.g. clinical stage); do not put file paths here.
description.title: Description

label.description: Group label; used for centroid subdir name (e.g. healthy, pcancer)
label.title: Label

level_labels_path.description: Optional path to CSV with columns mapping sample_path or sample name to level (path, level). When set, this group is expanded into one centroid dir per level; dir name is {label}_{level}.
level_labels_path.title: Level Labels Path

order_index.description: Optional numeric ordering hint for progression synthesis when JSON order is insufficient.
order_index.title: Order Index

sample_paths.description: List of sample directory paths, or paths to files containing one path per line, JSON array, or (when samples_base_path is set) one sample name per line / single column CSV.
sample_paths.title: Sample Paths

samples_base_path.description: Base directory to resolve sample names from file (overrides project-level samples_base_path). When set, entries in sample_paths files are treated as folder names and resolved to this path.
samples_base_path.title: Samples Base Path

stages.description: Optional child strata under this disease family (JSON key is 'stages' but children may be stage, molecular subtype, or any mutually exclusive bins—not only TNM stage). When set, parent must not use sample_paths; each child has its own label and sample_paths. Resolved centroid labels are {parent.label}_{child.label}. See methylutils/docs/COHORT_TREE.md.
stages.title: Stages

subcluster.description: When set, run MethylCluster on this group's samples; if persist_centroids, expand to one centroid per cluster.

GroupConfig.title: GroupConfig

SubclusterRequest.description:
Request to run MethylCluster on this group's samples before building centroids.
When enabled and persist_centroids is True, the group is expanded into one sub-group per
discovered cluster (e.g. healthy_c0, healthy_c1); centroids are built per cluster via MethylCentroid.
When persist_centroids is False, MethylCluster runs and writes assignments only; the group
remains a single centroid (all samples) as usual.

force_k.description: Force K clusters (centroid/hierarchical); bypasses automatic K selection
force_k.title: Force K

method.description: MethylCluster clustering method (centroid recommended for methylation data)
method.title: Method

metric.description: Distance metric for clustering (e.g. jensen_shannon, hellinger)
metric.title: Metric

min_cluster_size.description: Minimum samples per cluster (HDBSCAN); defaults to MethylCluster default if unset
min_cluster_size.title: Min Cluster Size

output_subdir.description: Subdir under project clustering output (default: side/group_label, e.g. control/healthy)
output_subdir.title: Output Subdir

persist_centroids.description: If True, run MethylCentroid per cluster and expand group to healthy_c0, healthy_c1, ...
persist_centroids.title: Persist Centroids

SubclusterRequest.title: SubclusterRequest

description:
Single source of truth for a MethylPipeline project.

Preferred schema:
- `controls` / `diseases` (or singular `control` / `disease`)
- explicit `comparisons`
- shared `chromosomes`, `contexts`, `path_remap`
- tool parameters live in pipeline profiles (`actionConfig`) and site manifest

Backward compatibility is retained for `group1`/`group2`, flat `groups`,
and a few historically nested keys that are promoted to the top level at
load time. ``step_config`` is not accepted (use profiles + site manifest).

cohort_hierarchy.description: Optional reporting tree: e.g. disease_families[{label, stage_labels[]}], control_strata[]. Filled automatically when using disease groups with stages if omitted.
cohort_hierarchy.title: Cohort Hierarchy

comparisons.description: When control+disease: list of {control_group, disease_group, comparison_label?} or shorthand: "control_vs_each_disease" (first control vs each disease), "all_pairs" (every control group × every disease leaf).
comparisons.title: Comparisons

control.description: When set with disease: control side (label + groups). Centroids go to centroids/controls/{group.label}.

disease.description: When set with control: disease side (label + groups). Centroids go to centroids/diseases/{disease_subdir}/{group.label}.

disease_name.description: Human-readable disease name for metadata (e.g. 'Prostate Cancer'). Use 'disease' when it's a string and 'diseases' for structure.
disease_name.title: Disease Name

group1.description: First cohort (e.g. control/healthy). Required when groups is not set.

group2.description: Second cohort (e.g. disease/cancer). Required when groups is not set.

groups.description: Optional N groups (overrides group1/group2 when set). Each group can have level_labels_path for stratification.
groups.title: Groups

output_base.description: Global output folder; each project uses a subfolder {output_base}/{project_name} for all step outputs
output_base.title: Output Base

path_remap.description: Prefix replacement when sample paths moved (e.g. NAS); longest match applied
path_remap.title: Path Remap

progression_labels.description: Explicit comparison tokens when progression_order is 'explicit'.
progression_labels.title: Progression Labels

progression_order.description: How to order disease stages for progression synthesis. Default: from_stages when nested stages exist.
progression_order.title: Progression Order

project_name.description: Project identifier for metadata and naming (e.g. PCa_vs_Healthy)
project_name.title: Project Name

samples_base_path.description: Base directory to resolve sample names. When set, group sample_paths that point to files can list only sample folder names (one per line or single-column CSV); each is resolved to this path.
samples_base_path.title: Samples Base Path

survival_path.description: Optional CSV sidecar for time-to-event modeling: sample_id, time, event, and optional psa/alp/ldh/predicted_ctdna_fraction. Operator-supplied; no in-process ctdna.org call.
survival_path.title: Survival Path

validation_partitions.description: Cohort partition CSV paths for validation governance (development_train, locked_test, …).
validation_partitions.title: Validation Partitions
